question: Who among the following was a noted Mridangam player who served as ‘Artist in Residence in Music’ at Wesleyan University from 1970 -1975 and again from 1988-2000 teaching South Indian drumming?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramnad V Raghavan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramnad V Raghavan **was a noted Mridangam player who served as an ‘Artist in Residence in Music’ at Wesleyan University from 1970 -1975 and again from 1988-2000 teaching South Indian drumming.
 
• Ramnad V. Raghavan was a South Indian player of the mridangam.
 
 
• He was born in **Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India.**
